CalendarAssistantDefaults.description: Default assistant for future calendar-scheduled Google Meet and Teams sessions. The saved configuration must fit within 8 KiB. Use id, audio_gate, dynamic_variables, and leave_on_end; avatar is not accepted. audio_gate defaults to full_duplex.

audio_gate.description: Use full_duplex (default) to allow participants to interrupt, or half_duplex to pause listening while the assistant speaks. Full-duplex pricing depends on participant audio usage; see the Meeting pricing guide.

dynamic_variables.description: Per-conversation values for the [dynamic variables](/docs/inference/ai-assistants/dynamic-variables) used in the Assistant's instructions, greeting, or tools. Delivered before the Assistant's first utterance, so they resolve for the opening line as well as the rest of the conversation. At most 63 entries; keys 1-128 characters; values must be strings. The map is budgeted in aggregate at 1,047,552 bytes (1023 KiB) rather than capped per value. `streaming_audio`, `ai_assistant_streaming_audio` and `meeting_session_id` are reserved and rejected with `400 invalid_request`.

id.description: Identifier of the assistant to attach.

leave_on_end.description: Leave when the assistant conversation ends or fails. Defaults to false. Other leave-policy rules and explicit leave requests still apply.

get.description: List only the authenticated connecting user’s calendar connections. Session resources created by those connections are shared within the organization.

post.description: Start Google Calendar or Microsoft Outlook OAuth. Open oauth_url in a browser. No connection exists until authorization succeeds. The resulting connection is owned by the connecting user.

delete.description: Disconnect the calendar, cancel future joins, and clear retained calendar identity fields. Previously created session records, transcripts, artifacts, and Storage objects remain. The response is the updated connection.

get.description: Retrieve a calendar connection owned by the authenticated connecting user. Missing and foreign connections both return 404. Signing secrets are omitted.

patch.description: Update policy or defaults for future sessions. Supply at least one field. Existing sessions retain their configuration. Null clears nullable overrides. Assistant, recording, and webhook defaults apply to Google Meet and Teams. Assistant defaults require default_barge_in to be false or null and default_voice to be null. Recording=true requires a destination; false rejects one. A non-null default_webhook_url update returns webhook_secret once; save it to verify future session deliveries.

get.description: List tracked meetings in a window. Defaults from now through seven days from now. from must not exceed to and the window must not exceed 31 days. bot_will_join is the effective policy decision; check session_id and the linked session status for actual attendance.

parameters.description: Window end; defaults to seven days from now.
parameters.name: to

patch.description: Set an individual meeting override: true opts in, false opts out, null follows the connection policy. A supported meeting link is required. Changes re-evaluate the meeting immediately; poll the linked session for its final lifecycle outcome.

get.description: Browser redirect after calendar consent. Use the returned oauth_url rather than constructing this request. Verified state identifies the connecting user. Returns HTML for success, cancellation, or failure; no JSON error envelope or bearer token is used.

parameters.description: Authorization code supplied by the calendar provider.
parameters.name: code

parameters.description: Unmodified signed state from the authorization URL.
parameters.name: state

parameters.description: Authorization error supplied by the calendar provider, such as access_denied.
parameters.name: error

200.description: Calendar connected, or the user cancelled authorization.

409.description: This user already has a connection for this calendar platform.
